messages:
Maya (AE): heads up team — Oscillon confirmed POC start next week but procurement stalled signing. Two blockers: they require a vendor-signed HSM attestation in the DPA and want to split the 6mo reserved commit into 3 quarterly invoices.
Liam (Legal): copy. please paste the PO text or portal link so I can scan for extra audit/indemnity asks.
Maya (AE): portal: https://portal.redwood.ai/uploads/OSC-PO-2026-9001.pdf. PO snippet:
```
PO#: OSC-PO-2026-9001
Amount: $54,000 (6-month reserved commit)
Instance: dedicated-6xA100
Billing: request quarterly invoicing (3 invoices)
Security: vendor-signed HSM attestation; DPA redline attached by customer
Signature: DocuSign to procurement@oscillon.io + legal@oscillon.io
```
Rohit (Solutions): Dedicated => BYO-KMS available. That should satisfy HSM attestation. If they try Hosted, wording changes. Also propose attaching a 1-page POC BOM (GPU hours, burst, monitoring credits) — procurement likes that.
Harper (Security): we have a signed HSM attestation template infra can fill. For vendor-signed attestation Liam will need to sign the addendum. I can add SOC2 excerpt and KMS flow diagram.
Diane (Finance): quarterly invoicing ok in principle. Need to know if invoices are at term-start or month-by-month. Quarterly for 6mo = 3 invoices; if invoice-at-term-start it's effectively prepay. That affects revenue recognition and exposure cap. Propose a $15k cap during POC.
Liam (Legal): I'll redline the customer DPA to narrow subprocessors and add an HSM addendum. Suggest countersign ETA 4 business days.
Maya (AE): procurement prefers DocuSign and asked for countersign within 5 business days on their side. I'll request signer names/emails.
redwood-bot: infra-note: dedicated-6xA100 us-west-2 pool spare capacity: 11% across canary nodes.
Rohit (Solutions): adding SLA suggestion for POC one-pager: p95 latency < 450ms, uptime target 99.5%, fallback to smaller model <1min. I'll draft and attach.
Harper (Security): action: I'll upload attestation template + SOC2 excerpt once Liam confirms addendum language.
Diane (Finance): action: hold on billing approval until I see signed PO PDF and invoice cadence final. If they want invoice-at-usage-start, need credit signoff.
Liam (Legal): action: will post DPA redline + HSM attestation addendum to portal by EOD and tag this thread.
Maya (AE): thanks — i'll collect signer emails and confirm whether they want invoice-at-term-start or usage-start. please @me when drafts land. :thumbsup:
